scope: All Pakistan and Bangladesh cities with at least 1,000,000 inhabitants in UN DESA World Urbanization Prospects 2025 File 21 (Degree of Urbanization city definition)

classification_definitions.loadable: An official, anonymous, machine-readable source exposes coded municipal budget or actual lines for a defensible legal-government anchor.
classification_definitions.partial: Official fiscal material exists, but it is document-only, covers only part of the anchor's finances, or the UN city spans multiple fiscal entities.
classification_definitions.hard_blocked: No reviewed public source meets both the machine-readable line-item and defensible fiscal-boundary requirements.

pakistan_agpr_ddo_service_page.evidence: The official AGPR page links DDO Budget & Exp Detail to the PIFRA DDOALV endpoint.

pakistan_pifra_ddo_dashboard.evidence: Potential national multi-city source. AGPR/CGA describes object-wise original, re-appropriated, final, released and spent amounts across all tiers, including local governments. On 2026-09-20 the HTTP endpoint timed out without response; HTTPS refused connection and an HTTPS-upgrading web fetch returned 502.

pakistan_fabs_citizen_data.evidence: Public FABS page publishes federal dashboards, but no anonymous municipal DDO export was discoverable there.

punjab_lgfmis.evidence: Official Local Government Financial Management Information System; the public response is a credential form posting to Console/LogonUser.asp, with no anonymous report or API.

punjab_lgcd_budget.evidence: Publishes department-wide annual allocation and utilization totals, not city-level coded lines.

kp_cfmis_login.evidence: Official e-Baldia municipal-finance workspace is role protected.

kp_cfmis_public.evidence: Anonymous records are auction and revenue-contract events, not municipal budget or execution lines.

sindh_finance_budget.evidence: Official coded provincial PDF budget books include Local Government and Transfer to Local Bodies, but do not publish complete municipal ledgers.

balochistan_budget.evidence: Official provincial budget books are PDF documents and do not expose a Quetta municipal ledger/export.

bangladesh_lgd_city_corporations.evidence: Official list of city corporations; it supports the legal-entity review and excludes Savar, Brahmanbaria, Kishoreganj and Kutubdia.

bangladesh_open_data_local_government.evidence: The reviewed Local-Govt plus CSV catalogue returned only the 1996 Upazila Monitoring Survey, not municipal finance.

bangladesh_sabre.evidence: Structured budget platform covers state-owned enterprises and autonomous bodies, not city corporations.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Karachi Metropolitan Corporation only; district municipal corporations, cantonments, development authorities and provincial entities excluded
cities.evidence: KMC publishes an official 2023-24 PDF with department budget totals; Sindh publishes coded provincial/local-government PDF schedules.
cities.blocker: No anonymous CSV, spreadsheet or API exposes KMC's coded line-item ledger, and KMC is only an anchor within the larger UN built-up area.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan Corporation Lahore anchor only
cities.evidence: Punjab LGFMIS holds coded local-government budgets and transactions.
cities.blocker: Credential-only LGFMIS; the public LGCD budget page contains department totals rather than Lahore lines.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan Corporation Faisalabad anchor only
cities.evidence: Punjab LGFMIS holds coded local-government budgets and transactions.
cities.blocker: Credential-only LGFMIS; no anonymous city-level coded export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan Corporation Islamabad and Capital Development Authority have overlapping, non-consolidated fiscal responsibilities
cities.evidence: CDA and MCI publish civic information, notices and service announcements.
cities.blocker: No reviewed consolidated coded municipal budget export; the UN city cannot be represented by one complete local fiscal entity.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Capital Metropolitan Government Peshawar anchor only
cities.evidence: KP CFMS identifies a municipal-finance workspace; the public portal identifies Capital Metropolitan Government Peshawar auction records.
cities.blocker: Finance reports require authentication; anonymous auction records are not budget execution.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan Corporation Gujranwala anchor only
cities.evidence: Punjab LGFMIS holds coded local-government budgets and transactions.
cities.blocker: Credential-only LGFMIS; no anonymous city-level coded export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan Corporation Multan anchor only
cities.evidence: Punjab LGFMIS holds coded local-government budgets and transactions.
cities.blocker: Credential-only LGFMIS; no anonymous city-level coded export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Hyderabad Municipal Corporation anchor only
cities.evidence: Sindh publishes coded provincial Local Government and Transfer to Local Bodies PDF schedules.
cities.blocker: The schedules are provincial/document-only and do not expose Hyderabad Municipal Corporation's complete coded accounts.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Municipal Corporation Sialkot anchor only
cities.evidence: Punjab LGFMIS holds coded local-government budgets and transactions.
cities.blocker: Credential-only LGFMIS; no anonymous city-level coded export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Tehsil Local Government Mardan anchor only
cities.evidence: KP CFMS covers municipal finance and revenue workflows.
cities.blocker: Finance reports require authentication; no anonymous coded budget export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan or municipal corporation Sargodha anchor only, subject to current Punjab local-government constitution
cities.evidence: Punjab LGFMIS holds coded local-government budgets and transactions.
cities.blocker: Credential-only LGFMIS; current legal entity and anonymous line export both require verification.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Metropolitan Corporation Quetta anchor only
cities.evidence: Balochistan publishes official provincial budget books and development programs.
cities.blocker: PDF-only provincial publications do not expose a complete Quetta municipal coded ledger or machine-readable export.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Tehsil Local Government Babuzai/Mingora anchor only
cities.evidence: KP CFMS public auctions identify TMA Babuzai while its finance workspace is role protected.
cities.blocker: Finance reports require authentication, and the Babuzai-to-UN-Mingora anchor boundary must remain explicitly partial.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Dhaka North City Corporation and Dhaka South City Corporation are separate fiscal entities; neither alone covers the UN city
cities.evidence: DNCC publishes annual budgets, annual administrative reports and annual statements of accounts; DSCC separately publishes annual budgets at https://dscc.gov.bd/pages/static-pages/6922df09933eb65569e1f646.
cities.blocker: Reviewed attachments are PDFs, not CSV/XLS/API, and a defensible Dhaka anchor requires at least two non-consolidated corporations.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Chattogram City Corporation anchor only
cities.evidence: Official page publishes annual budgets, BACS budgets, receipts/payments and annual accounts; 20 resolved attachment URLs reviewed were PDFs.
cities.blocker: No spreadsheet, CSV or API surfaced; document extraction would not meet the machine-readable-source rule.

cities.fiscal_boundary: UN Savar built-up area spans Savar municipality/upazila and surrounding jurisdictions
cities.evidence: Savar is absent from the official city-corporation list.
cities.blocker: No single city-corporation fiscal anchor and no official machine-readable consolidated municipal budget source found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Brahmanbaria municipality is only a fragment of the UN built-up area
cities.evidence: Brahmanbaria is absent from the official city-corporation list; government portals expose scattered upazila and municipality documents.
cities.blocker: No single matching fiscal entity and no official machine-readable coded municipal budget export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Kishoreganj municipality is only a fragment of the UN built-up area
cities.evidence: Kishoreganj is absent from the official city-corporation list; nearby upazila and union portals publish non-consolidated documents/pages.
cities.blocker: No single matching fiscal entity and no official machine-readable coded municipal budget export found.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Sylhet City Corporation anchor only
cities.evidence: Official portal publishes annual procurement plans tied to revenue and development budgets and a narrative 2023-24 budget at https://scc.gov.bd/pages/news/6922d8ec933eb65569dfb410.
cities.blocker: No coded CSV/XLS/API surfaced; direct retrieval of the attachment page returned HTTP 403 during review.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Khulna City Corporation anchor only
cities.evidence: Khulna City Corporation is an official city-corporation fiscal anchor and follows the national portal publication model.
cities.blocker: No official machine-readable coded budget or actual export surfaced; available publication evidence is document/page based.

cities.fiscal_boundary: Kutubdia upazila/island has no city-corporation fiscal entity matching the UN built-up area
cities.evidence: Kutubdia is absent from the official city-corporation list.
cities.blocker: No defensible single municipal anchor and no official machine-readable consolidated local budget source found.
